detailed_descriptions.en: Grail is a fantasy autobattler where your deck plays automatically! Take on foes in pitched card battles that play out before your eyes. Test your deck building prowess against monsters and other players. Stack wins together and climb your way from lowly blade-for-hire to a master of the auto-battling arts! Overview PvP autobattler deckbuilder Fast runs that take between 15min - 45min Multiple playable characters, each with their own unique pool of cards 250+ cards and 100+ traits Unlock all characters and cosmetics by playing the game Fights play out automatically. Focus entirely on creating clever synergies by strategizing in between battles. Collect new cards, make them stronger by upgrading, adjusting or enchanting them. Gain specialized traits or find secret events. Then watch another fight unfold! Pick a hero from a growing roster of characters each with their unique pool of cards and playstyle. Collect trophies by winning games, which you can use to unlock cosmetics for your characters! Is it even real? Why is everyone after it? Find out by unlocking pieces of lore for winning games with different cards. And who knows, maybe you will find it after all!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Grail is a fantasy autobattler where your deck plays automatically! Take on foes in pitched card battles that play out before your eyes.
Test your deck building prowess against monsters and other players. Stack wins together and climb your way from lowly blade-for-hire to a master of the auto-battling arts!

Overview
  • PvP autobattler deckbuilder
  • Fast runs that take between 15min - 45min
  • Multiple playable characters, each with their own unique pool of cards
  • 250+ cards and 100+ traits
  • Unlock all characters and cosmetics by playing the game


Fights play out automatically. Focus entirely on creating clever synergies by strategizing in between battles. Collect new cards, make them stronger by upgrading, adjusting or enchanting them. Gain specialized traits or find secret events. Then watch another fight unfold!


Pick a hero from a growing roster of characters each with their unique pool of cards and playstyle.
Collect trophies by winning games, which you can use to unlock cosmetics for your characters!


Is it even real? Why is everyone after it? Find out by unlocking pieces of lore for winning games with different cards. And who knows, maybe you will find it after all!
